About this item

  • 【Bright & Multi-Lighting Modes】 SIBRILLE LED desk lamp, wide range of brightness & color adjustment; SHORT press the button to quickly adjust the 5 color temperatures or brightness step by step, or LONG press for steplessly dimming (10% - 100%) or tempering (2700K - 6500K, while others are 3000K-5500K). The memory function will keep your last setting.
  • 【Eye Friendly】SIBRILLE desk light, with high color rendering index LED beads, close to the natural light, flicker-free and less blue light hazard. The lampshade is frosted design, which can provide soft and anti-glare light, very easy on eyes. Suitable for work, gaming, computer, monitor and home office use.
  • 【Flexible Lamp Head & Ultra Wide Coverage】This computer desk lamp, designed with 2 light bars, 30in long, 0-180°extension, so it can provide enough light for the whole desk. And the the gooseneck can be adjusted to any direction and position you like.
  • 【Built-in Cord & Buckle Installation】 In order to make the desktop tidy, we specially designed the recessed power cord, the desktop lamp looks very modern streamlined, and your desktop will not be messy. In addition, our table lamp is assembled by buckle, no need to screw a lot, very easy to assemble.
  • 【Space Saving】Our LED architect work lamp dissipates heat well, with a long service life, no need to replace frequently. With the thick clamp base (working height 2.75in), you can set it up on any desk or tables without taking over your desktop. It’s space saving.

Product description

Special Feature

Stepless dimmable, color changing, brightness adjustable, integrated energy-saving LED, remote & touch control.

Modern design, easy assembly, rotatable lamp head, timer function, memory function, large clamp, space saving.

Previous page
Next page

Remote Control Desk Lamp

This computer desk light can be controlled by both touch and remote. Allowing you to choose the most suitable brightness and color faster without standing up.

Bendable Lamp Head

This LED desk lamp can be bended or twisted. You can adjust the height or position, enabling you to direct the light precisely where it’s needed.

Foldable Swing Arms

This desk lighting has 2 flexible swing light bars, which can be extended up to 180° to 31.5 in. It can evenly cover a desk with a width of 71 in, providing sufficient and comfortable lighting. Also, you can fold them, so you can place it at the side of the desk.

      Best Lamp I've Owned

      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      It is without a doubt the best lamp I've had the privilege of buying. It feels, looks, and functions at a premium and high quality.

      The neck of the lamp is what I'd consider nearly perfectly balanced between flexibility and sturdiness. With the adjustable angles of the light bars themselves, as well as the neck, it will unquestionably meet your positional needs.

      The touch controls are practically flawless. They work every time they are pressed, as inputted without fail. They are positioned as such you can easily identify and press them at any time without having a clear visual of them.

      I was extremely satisfied with the quality of light itself. The range of warmth/cool strikes a node of nostalgia and comfort for me that is difficult to explain. They are arranged perfectly, and can satisfy any particular need for a specific light task by task throughout your day. The brightness levels do not fail to complement this standard, there are a satisfactory amount of levels ranging from beautifully ambient dim to possibly light up the room.

      A more niche comment, my desk has oddly positioned metal framing that goes underneath in a rectangle. It is often difficult for clamp based items to function on my desk because of it, but the size of this clamp was so good it still managed to clamp all the way up and firmly onto the edge of my desk. I saved plenty of space with this lamp.

      I have literally 0 complaints. I'd buy it again.

      Reviewed in the United States on May 16, 2024

      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      This lamp is much nicer than I expected. It lights up my entire desk, and it's very well made. The light doesn't produce any glare, either. The assembly is easy, with one screw at the base you screw in with the included screwdriver. I like the multiple light colors that you can pick, based on lighting conditions or just your mood at the time. The controls are touch operated, there's blue tiny LED by the power button that indicates the lamp is plugged in. This blue LED turns off when the lamp is on, so it won't shine in your eyes, which is good design. Also, the lamp automatically returns to the previous color and brightness settings you had when you turned it off, which is very convenient. The lamp gooseneck seems to be high quality, and the lights swivel a full 180 degrees. The housing is nice aluminum, and the gooseneck is a nice rubber-like material. The cord properly runs through the lamp, hidden, unlike cheaper models of this lamp. Overall, I highly recommend this version over the others. I searched, and it seemed to me this was the best version. It might not be the absolute best, but it seems to be high enough quality and of a good design to last a long time. Recommend.

      Light up your world

      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

      I read a lot of reviews but don’t often leave them. But when I do, it’s usually because I feel compelled to because of how good I find the product.

      And yes, I know, it’s a lamp.

      Maybe it’s because I have astigmatism where dimly lit areas cause my to strain my eyes but I really am a big fan of this lamp. I’ve got it clipped to a stand up desk and it provides all the light and adjustment I would ever need. You can change the colour from white to yellow ish, brightness etc. I’ve got it on 3/5 for brightness leaving some room for increasing it if I need to. Fantastic. I love how you can adjust the arm and the lights themselves in a bunch of different directions.

      The build quality seems reasonable so far. My only hope is that it lasts for a good bunch of years. I’d say 10 years is a reasonable ask? So far we’re a month in and it’s been great.

      For absolute top marks, it would be great to be able to replace the lights themselves somehow. Don’t think that’s the case. Room for improvement perhaps!
